title: What is NimbusDesk?
content: NimbusDesk is a synthetic, fictional customer engagement product used only as demo data for this portfolio project. It represents a typical SaaS helpdesk and CRM platform with chat, voice, and messaging channels.

title: How do I reset my password?
content: Go to Settings > Account > Security and click 'Reset Password'. You'll receive a reset link by email that expires after 30 minutes.

title: What are your business hours?
content: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm IST. Enterprise plans include 24/5 support with a 1-hour response SLA.

title: What pricing plans are available?
content: NimbusDesk offers three plans: Starter (up to 3 seats), Growth (up to 20 seats, includes WhatsApp channel), and Enterprise (unlimited seats, includes GraphRAG knowledge search and dedicated support).

title: How do I integrate WhatsApp with NimbusDesk?
content: In Settings > Channels > WhatsApp, connect your WhatsApp Business API account and verify the phone number. Growth and Enterprise plans support WhatsApp; Starter does not.

title: What is your refund policy?
content: Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime with no refund for the current billing cycle. Annual plans are refundable on a prorated basis within the first 30 days.

title: How do I export my data?
content: Go to Settings > Data > Export to request a full export of conversations, customers, and leads as a CSV/JSON bundle. Exports are generated asynchronously and emailed within 24 hours.

title: Is my data encrypted?
content: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2+ and at rest with AES-256. This is a synthetic policy statement for demo purposes only.

title: How do I contact support?
content: Use the in-app chat widget, email support@example.com, or ask this assistant to hand you off to a human agent.

title: Can I add multiple team members?
content: Yes, from Settings > Team > Invite Member. Seat limits depend on your plan: Starter (3), Growth (20), Enterprise (unlimited).
